name: Flashbang
body:
School evocation [fire, light]; Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of phosphorus)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 20-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous; see text
Saving Throw Fortitude partial, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a flash of bright fire in the area. Sighted creatures are blinded for 2d8 rounds. A successful Fortitude save reduces the effect to dazzled. Creatures outside the radius of the burst but within 120 feet of its center must make a Fortitude save or be blinded for 2d4 rounds, if they have line-of-sight on the flashbang. A successful save negates the effect for them altogether.
